matter_name: Halcyon Semiconductor AG/Inc. - DOJ NSD Export Control Inquiry (NSD-CES-2025-04871)
matter_description: Defense of Halcyon Semiconductor AG and its US subsidiary Halcyon Semiconductor Inc. in a DOJ National Security Division/Counterintelligence and Export Control Section inquiry into shipments of export-controlled HCA-9100 series chipsets to PRC-based end users, including an internal investigation, a voluntary self-disclosure to BIS, and negotiation of an administrative settlement agreement with a civil penalty and compliance monitor.
matter_type: regulatory investigation - export control / national security enforcement defense (white collar)

client.name: Halcyon Semiconductor AG and Halcyon Semiconductor Inc.
client.entity_type: Halcyon Semiconductor AG: Swiss corporation, publicly listed on XETRA/Frankfurt Stock Exchange (ticker HCA); Halcyon Semiconductor Inc.: wholly owned US subsidiary

counterparties.name: U.S. Department of Justice, National Security Division, Counterintelligence and Export Control Section (NSD/CES)
Bureau of Industry and Security, Office of Export Enforcement (U.S. Dept. of Commerce)

other_parties.name: Braxton Merritt LLP (Elena Voss)
other_parties.role: co-counsel - corporate and securities counsel to Halcyon

other_parties.name: Kessler Pratt & Whitfield LLP (Dr. Tobias Engel)
other_parties.role: co-counsel - German and EU export control counsel

other_parties.name: Ashford Pennington (Dr. Miriam Hecht)
other_parties.role: compliance consultant (Phase I/Phase II compliance review, monitor-readiness)

other_parties.role: PRC end-user recipient of shipments under investigation

other_parties.role: PRC end-user recipient of shipments under investigation (ultimately carved out of violations)

Entry of appearance letter sent to DOJ NSD/CES
OFAC and sanctions exposure analysis completed - no violations found

Company's redline of settlement agreement submitted to DOJ
Call with DOJ NSD/CES on redline positions; status update to client
